intent: From the cohort VCF take the four samples of population A (A1 to A4) and keep the variants whose allele frequency within those four samples is at least 20%.
silent_error: bcftools view -s recalculates only INFO/AC and INFO/AN for the retained samples; INFO/AF keeps the whole-cohort value. The frequency filter in the same command therefore uses the stale cohort AF: sites that are monomorphic in population A (AC=0) but common in the cohort are kept, and sites common in A but rare in the cohort are dropped. Output looks consistent (AC/AN look updated), no message, exit 0. Documented in the bcftools man page (view -I/--no-update: 'do not (re)calculate INFO fields for the subset (currently INFO/AC and INFO/AN)'; other tags have to be recomputed, e.g. with +fill-tags).

clean: bcftools view -s A1,A2,A3,A4 -Ou cohort.vcf | bcftools +fill-tags -Ou -- -t AF | bcftools view -i 'INFO/AF>=0.2' -o popA.vcf
